name: New Year's Eve Miracle
source:
Everyone in the magical winter forest is making preparations for a New Year celebration. Mousekin can't wait for his favorite holiday because on this day one's dearest wish will definitely come true.

This is a short cute visual novel about New Year's magic, friendship and miracles.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1971750/New_Years_Eve_Miracle/]Steam[/url]]
